profile.name: 被动监测实验界面后端
profile.description: 一个非物理的软件组件，用于被动监测实验的界面与通信协调。它负责通过 VISA 连接并配置 Keithley 2400、Keithley 2182 和 Lakeshore 温控相关仪器，读取测量值与温度数据，并管理实验启动、停止、日志和界面状态。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for coordinating the GUI and instrument communication in a passive monitoring experiment. It connects to and configures Keithley 2400, Keithley 2182, and Lakeshore temperature-control-related instruments over VISA, acquires measurement and temperature data, and manages experiment start/stop, logging, and UI state.

registry.name: Variable Temperature (Passive)
registry.description: Variable Temperature Backend (Passive)是一款表征设备，主要功能包括停止、参数配置、启动、扫描、日志记录、测量。支持Signal, Slot, create widgets等操作。
